what.text: This page follows refugees from Lithuania in all host countries, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 101 Lithuanian refugees, and Russia hosted 50.5% of them.
After Russia, the largest hosts are Germany, the United States and Canada.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict and no dated events for Lithuania, so it does not say why people left.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2002 to 2006.

when.text: UNHCR's series starts in 1990 at 5 refugees, and the figure was at its highest, 1535, at the end of 2003.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took.
These are year-end totals summed over every host country that reported to UNHCR.
